name: Alamo City Comic Con
blurb: A San Antonio comics, gaming, anime, collectibles and cosplay convention, now run under the AOG Events Xpo umbrella.
notes: AOG Events Xpo is one company/site (aogeventsxpo.com) running several branded shows (Alamo City Comic Con, Pokeverse Expo, and others) -- used ACCC's own page (/blank-7/accc), not the shared homepage, for its info. That page reads only 'DETAILS COMING SOON ON NEXT ACCC', with no dates, venue or guests, so editions is left empty. No ACCC-specific key art is live on the site yet either (its /guests, /cosplay links are unbuilt Wix placeholder pages, 'blank'/'blank-1'); cover uses the site's AOG Events Xpo wordmark, the only branded image present, consistent with the 'logo is fine when it's all there is' rule.
